messages:
Alex: Heads up — noticed a weird edgecase when we surfaced SLO alerts in the console with routing affinity + per-tenant quieting. Two problems: 1) dup notifications when a rule matches multiple routes, 2) quota burn not counted if notify is suppressed by quieting. Anyone seen this? :thinking:
Priya: yup saw it in canary yesterday, tenant foo had 3 notifications in 30s even though only one alert. probably our fanout runs before the quiet-window check.
Tomas: that's my suspicion too. current flow: evaluate SLO -> expand routes -> enqueue notifications -> apply contact-level snooze. We should apply quieting earlier and de-dup post-route expansion.
Mei: could we instead change the API to return a canonical 'delivery_key' so downstream notify-service can dedupe? e.g. `delivery_key = hash(slo_id, fingerprint, route_id)`
Alex: if route_id included then dedupe won't catch cross-route duplicates. maybe fingerprint should include alert fingerprint + tenant id and we run dedupe as last step before sending to external targets.
Priya: performance caveat: we can't add heavy de-dupe lookups in the critical path for every token. What if we add a short-lived in-memory bloomfilter per deployment to catch duplicates within a minute?
Tomas: bloomfilter helps but we need reliable billing counts. Quota burn for suppressed not counted is bigger issue — metrics pipeline expects a 'notified=true' event to increment budget.
Jordan: proposal: emit three events from notify pipeline: candidate_evaluated, suppressed(reason), delivered(methods). That keeps telemetry accurate and lets billing exclude suppressed events.
Mei: +1. Also API change: add `suppress_reason` enum on candidate_evaluated so console can show why a notification didn't fire.
Alex: UX question — in console rollout, how do we surface that a rule is being suppressed by tenant quieting vs noise-filtering? users confuse 'not firing' with 'misconfigured'.
Priya: show a little pill on the SLO card: `Suppressed — tenant quieting (5m)` with link to the quieting policy. Minimal copy.
Tomas: implementation detail: order of operations should be: evaluate -> apply quieting & noise filters -> expand routes -> dedupe -> emit delivered. That avoids duplicate deliveries and keeps billing right.
alert-bot: deploy queued: notify-service v2.14 will include suppressed event emission and delivery_key header — scheduled canary at 03:00 UTC.
Alex: ok let's document API fields for candidate_evaluated and suppressed events in the notify-api spec. Tomas/Priya, can you pair on a small PR for the change? :thumbsup:
Priya: on it. I'll draft API surface and add test cases for quota counting.
Tomas: will add bloomfilter POC and gating flag so we can toggle in prod.
Mei: I'll update console copy and add the pill states. Will link to quieting policy details.
Jordan: I'll add telemetry dashboards for suppressed vs delivered so we can monitor unintended suppression rate.
Alex: thanks all — follow-up in PRs. if deploy-bot shows any errors ping here.
